info.title: MICROSERVICE_PROD_Systems Assurance Assessments API
info.description: The Systems Assurance Assessments API enables users to initiate and manage assessments related to IT management systems. This API serves as a vital tool for organizations looking to evaluate their systems' compliance and operational effectiveness. Typical consumers include IT managers and compliance officers who require reliable means for assessment submissions and monitoring outcomes. By facilitating streamlined assessment processes, this API supports enhanced decision-making and strategic improvements within IT infrastructures.

post.summary: Create a new systems assurance assessment
post.description: This endpoint allows users to create a new assessment in the systems assurance framework, enabling the evaluation of IT systems against established assurance criteria.

requestBody.description: This request body is used to submit a new assessment within the systems assurance module of IT management. It should contain all necessary fields according to the defined schema.
